recommendation: Keep the fix. Future LOINC usage-page details should remain in THO/UTG, but the FHIR-core license page should not retain stale local LOINC copyright years after FHIR-28295 and the FHIR-35933 migration.
issue_request: FHIR-28295 asked to update the Using LOINC with FHIR page by removing the dated LOINC copyright text and replacing it with a reference to terminology.hl7.org for copyright information; it is Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5.
initial_application: Commit 8cd675bf1d pre-applied the issue by updating source/loinc.html and source/license.html to a 1995-2020 LOINC statement. Commit 0bcb947d84 later changed source/loinc.html to refer to terminology.hl7.org, but source/license.html retained the stale dated wording.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later removed source/loinc.html from FHIR core and moved external-code-system usage pages to THO, so the old LOINC page is no longer the core reconciliation target. source/license.html remains in the current build via publish.ini, hierarchy/navigation, and the footer. The original CodeSystem-v3-loinc current URL is no longer live, while the THO LOINC NamingSystem page provides current copyright/license text.
reconciliation: Changed source/license.html to remove the dated LOINC copyright/license sentence and point to the HL7 Terminology LOINC NamingSystem for current copyright and license information, without restoring or editing the removed local LOINC usage page.
source_changes: source/license.html: replaced the stale LOINC 1995-2020 copyright/license statement with a reference to the HL7 Terminology LOINC NamingSystem for current copyright and license information.
